description: This file defines structures and classes related to TLS pinning and security for a WebSocket session, including handling of trust challenges, storing fingerprint data, and managing migration from legacy storage.

classes.name: GatewayTLSPinningSession
classes.description: A WebSocket session class that handles TLS pinning and trust challenge responses for secure communications.

methods.name: loadFingerprint
methods.description: Loads a stored fingerprint for a given stable ID, handling migration if necessary.

methods.name: saveFingerprint
methods.description: Saves a fingerprint string associated with a stable ID.

methods.name: clearFingerprint
methods.description: Removes a stored fingerprint for a specific stable ID.

methods.name: makeWebSocketTask
methods.description: Creates a WebSocketTask with the specified URL.

methods.name: urlSession(_:didReceive:completionHandler:)
methods.description: Handles server trust challenges during a URLSession connection, validating fingerprints or falling back to default handling.
